units.notes: Strategy: Mediator holds a ctor-injected INotificationPublisher _publisher field and PublishCore delegates through it; ForeachAwaitPublisher and TaskWhenAllPublisher are the interchangeable concrete strategies - all participants in-unit. Deliberately NOT labeled Mediator/Chain of Responsibility despite the library's name: handlers are resolved from IServiceProvider and the pipeline chains via RequestHandlerDelegate delegates, so no colleague-holds-mediator and no successor-of-own-abstraction structure exists (structure over branding). Wrappers/ are pure abstract dispatch hierarchies - no concrete-calls-abstract skeleton, so no Template Method.
Deliberate negative: four marker interfaces (IRequest, INotification, IStreamRequest) and the Unit struct; no collaboration at all.

Deliberate negative nested inside the src/MediatR unit (overlap intentional - a detector firing here is penalized in both units): License/LicenseAccessor/LicenseValidator plus enums; LicenseAccessor caches a Lazy<License> of ANOTHER type, so not Singleton.
